name: self_evolution
description: Self-evolving agent loop inspired by Dr. Zero. Proposes questions/problems, solves them using available tools, and evolves through iteration - no training data required. Reports progress, findings, and self-improvement metrics. Nothing is read from or symlinked to another folder; everything is written inside this project.

operation.description: One of: sources | sources_list | backends | evolve | evolve_once | run_evolution | self_evolve | sources_list. Defaults to sources.

concept.description: Topic/concept to evolve a question about (for evolve operation).

domain.description: Knowledge domain for evolve operation (e.g. science, coding, security, math).

skill.description: Skill name to evolve with (for evolve operation).

authorized.description: Must be true for operations that contact external sources or write to disk.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually run evolution (not just preview).

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 20.

author: Stella
notes: Read-only sources/manifest queries are free. Evolving requires authorized=true + confirm=true. Nothing is symlinked or read from another folder; everything is written inside this project.
